rules.statement: A conditional transfer treated as a mortgage for the purpose of the Debt Conciliation Board's jurisdiction does not entail the consequence that title remains with the vendor (debtor).
rules.supporting_quote: This argument was rightly rejected. It was held that a conditional transfer was treated as a mortgage only for purposes of the jurisdiction of the board and that such recognition by the board as mortgage did not entail the consequence that title remained with the vendor (debtor)
